params.name: queryId
params.description: Identifier of the query which is going to be executed.

params.name: parameters
params.description: Key and value of the parameters to be replaced within the NQL query in order to compose a final query for execution. Example: {\"alert_name\": \"my_alert\", \"alert_status\": \"Open\"}"

params.name: compression
params.description: The compression algorithm for the export. If not set, no compression is applied. Allowed values: `NONE`, `ZSTD`, `GZIP`.

items.docs: Starts the execution of a query that will finish with the export of the results to a file in S3. The service response contains an identifier that can be used in the "status" operation to obtain the URL of the file with the results.
